prompt: A desktop landing page for Quatro Ventos, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese text, no browser window and no device frame. A technical buyer comparing agencies must see the offer and start a quote on the page itself. The page is the white cleanroom bench, flat, not a marketing card on a blank page. Reading order: a thin equipment rail across the top, the name Quatro Ventos at the left, and the links Desenvolvimento de sites, Manutenção de sites, Hospedagem, Suporte engraved small at the right. The left two thirds is one cropped word, Repeat, in ink so large it is the wall. Beneath it a tiny line: Estamos prontos para criar, programar e cuidar do seu site. Set into the bench, one illuminated control, the only teal, reads Faça um orçamento sem compromisso! The right third is one vertical column of six identical station labels: Arquitetura, Prototipagem, Frontend, Backend, Homologação, Entrega. Only Arquitetura is lit teal. At the bottom edge the next section begins with the sentence Nosso primeiro passo é estudar o fluxo de navegação do usuário. Ground is #FDFFFC. Ink is #011627. The only #2EC4B6 is the lit station and the quote control. Light grotesque. No cards, no laptop photo, no testimonial, no logo row.
